items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight And Urbanlink Air Mobility Sign Mou To Advance Electronic Flight Bag And Dispatch Standards For Advanced Air Mobility In South Florida
items.summary: MIAMI, FL and AUSTIN, TX – July 28, 2026 – Jeppesen ForeFlight and UrbanLink Air Mobility today announced they have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to collaborate on electronic flight bag (EFB) requirements and dispatch procedures supporting electric vertical takeoff and landing (e-VTOL) and other all-electric aircraft operations in the South Florida airspace.

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight Brings Largest Product Line Up New Promotions To Eaa Airventure 2026
items.summary: AUSTIN, Texas - July 16, 2026 - Jeppesen ForeFlight is bringing a sweeping wave of new products, upgraded features, special pricing, promotions and more at EAA AirVenture Oshkosh 2026. The offerings span artificial intelligence, panel-connected cockpit hardware, aviation insurance, and flight school scheduling and operations.

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight Unveils Airflow
items.summary: AUSTIN, Texas — July 1, 2026 — Jeppesen ForeFlight today unveiled its aviation-centric AI engine, the foundation of its strategy to bring responsible artificial intelligence to all sectors of aviation. Jeppesen ForeFlight Airflow™ has been developed over the last several years, backed by decades of deep domain experience, industry-leading data, and capabilities spanning crew and fleet planning, day-of-flight operations, and flight deck solutions.

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight Expands Relationship With Avia Solutions Group
items.summary: AUSTIN, TEXAS – JUNE 18, 2026 – Jeppesen ForeFlight today announced a new agreement with Avia Solutions Group, the world’s largest ACMI (Aircraft, Crew, Maintenance, Insurance) provider, to deploy an integrated suite of digital flight deck and data solutions across its global portfolio of airlines.

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight Achieves Department Of Defense Impact Level 5 Authorization
items.summary: AUSTIN, TEXAS — JUNE 16, 2026 — Jeppesen ForeFlight today announced it has received a Department of Defense Impact Level 5 (IL5) Authority to Operate. IL5 is the highest cybersecurity authorization available for unclassified cloud systems. The Authority to Operate enables military and defense organizations to deploy ForeFlight for sensitive, mission-critical operations with full regulatory confidence, and applies across the Department of Defense, with reciprocity available to all military branches, federal agencies, and allied partners.

items.title: Korean Air Selects Jeppesen Dispatch
items.summary: DENVER – May 27, 2026 – Jeppesen ForeFlight today announced that Korean Air has selected Jeppesen Dispatch as its future flight planning system, marking a significant milestone as the first major airline to adopt the platform across its future integrated fleet of more than 230 aircraft.

items.title: Pan Am Adopts Jeppesen Foreflights Electronic Flight Bag Solution For Its Flight Operations
items.summary: MIAMI, FL and DENVER, CO – May 20, 2026– As Pan American World Airways (Pan Am) begins the journey to restore its iconic brand to the skies, the company has selected Jeppesen ForeFlight to support flight operations with its Electronic Flight Bag (EFB).

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight And Ge Aerospace Collaborate To Deliver End To End Airline Fuel Savings Solution
items.summary: EVENDALE, Ohio & DENVER – April 30, 2026 – Jeppesen ForeFlight and GE Aerospace (NYSE: GE) today announced a collaboration that brings together GE Aerospace’s flight data analytics platform with Jeppesen ForeFlight’s Cost Index Optimization solution. Combined, these solutions offer airlines a continuous fuel efficiency workflow that spans pre-flight planning, in-flight optimization, and post-flight analysis to identify fuel savings opportunities.

items.title: Jeppesen Foreflight Announces Three Executive Appointments To Drive Growth And Innovation
items.summary: DENVER, December 16, 2025 – Jeppesen ForeFlight, a leading aviation software company dedicated to advancing the future of flight through innovative technology, today announced the appointment of three senior executives to its leadership team. Joe Ayers joins as chief financial officer (CFO), Toya Del Valle has joined as chief customer officer (CCO), and Richa Gupta will assume the role of chief people officer as of January 5, 2026.
